# Precision Farm MCP -- Synthetic Data

**All data in this directory is synthetic.** It was generated by `generator/` for one fictional North Dakota corn/soybean operation and is not derived from any real farm, field, or grower.

- Seed: `42`
- Root fields: 12
- Seasons: 2016-2025 (10 seasons)
- Generator version: 1.0.0

Regenerate identically with:

```bash
uv run python -m farm_data_gen.cli --seed 42 --fields 12 --seasons 10 --out data/synthetic
```

## Outputs

| Directory / file | Format | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `boundaries/` | GeoJSON, one file per season | CRS varies by season -- see `ground_truth.json` `identity_events` / per-season files for which |
| `yield_monitor/` | CSV, one file per field per season | Absent for the two oldest seasons (older combine) |
| `scale_tickets/` | CSV, one file per season | Authoritative bushel source |
| `as_applied/` | CSV, one file per season | Newest 4 seasons only |
| `cost_ledger.xlsx` | XLSX workbook | One tab per season plus a shared `Unit Prices` tab; this is the farmer's own messy spreadsheet |
| `ground_truth.json` | JSON | Exact expected profit per field per season, every injected defect with a stable ID, and the field-identity event graph |

## Why each defect exists

Every defect below is deliberate and recorded in `ground_truth.json` under `defects[]` with a stable `defect_id`, so a downstream test suite can assert each one was actually detected and handled -- a generator that only produced clean data would let a broken profitability engine pass its tests for free.

### ambiguous_alias_tie

- `DEF-ALIASTIE-2023-root_03` (season 2023): Cost ledger name 'Hom Corner' in season 2023 doesn't exactly match any boundary name, and 'Home Quarter' and 'Section Corner' have identical acreage that season -- acreage alone can't disambiguate, and string similarity favors the wrong field ('Section Corner', verified via difflib.get_close_matches).

### Spreadsheet mess: total-dollars cost basis

- `DEF-BASIS-2018` (season 2018): The 2018 cost tab reports Seed/Fertilizer/Chemical/Fuel/Cash Rent as total dollars for the field, not $/ac as in every other season -- the column headers say so, but a parser assuming a constant basis across seasons would misread it by ~acres-fold.

### Management shortfall (yield override)

- `DEF-MGMTSHORTFALL-2023-root_11` (season 2023): 'Coulee Field''s 2023 yield was deliberately knocked to 65% of what that season's weather and soil alone would have produced -- a direct management-shortfall override under otherwise ordinary weather, not a weather effect.

### Field merge

- `evt_merge_root_07_root_08` (season 2022): Elevator Forty and Depot Forty merged into Elevator Forty-Depot Forty starting season 2022.

### Missing swath (GPS dropout)

- `DEF-SWATH-2024-root_10` (season 2024): GPS dropout on Marginal Eighty: no yield monitor points recorded in the eastern 11% of the field, though it was fully harvested.

### Naming drift

- `DEF-NAMEDRIFT-root_04`: 'N 80' appears in the cost ledger's Field column under different spellings by season: 2016='N 80', 2017='north eighty', 2018='North 80', 2019='N80', 2020='N 80', 2021='north eighty', 2022='North 80', 2023='N80', 2024='N 80', 2025='north eighty'

### No monitor at all

- `DEF-NOMONITOR-2016` (season 2016): No yield monitor files exist for 2016 (older combine, no monitor); scale tickets are the only yield source that season.
- `DEF-NOMONITOR-2017` (season 2017): No yield monitor files exist for 2017 (older combine, no monitor); scale tickets are the only yield source that season.

### prompt_injection_notes

- `DEF-INJECTION-2020-root_01` (season 2020): The Notes cell for West 120 in 2020 contains prompt-injection-style text instead of a normal freeform note.

### Field renamed

- `evt_rename_root_06` (season 2021): Farmer renamed River Bottom to Riverside starting season 2021; it is the same ground.

### Rental ground lost

- `evt_rental_lost_root_09` (season 2020): Township Rd 12 was rented ground; lease ended after season 2019. No boundary exists thereafter.

### Field split

- `evt_split_root_05` (season 2020): South 160 split into South 160 North and South 160 South starting season 2020.

### Spreadsheet mess: blank rows

- `DEF-BLANKROWS-2021` (season 2021): The 2021 cost tab has blank rows inserted mid-table.

### Spreadsheet mess: merged header cells

- `DEF-MERGEDHEADER-2016` (season 2016): The 2016 cost tab has a merged 'Input Costs' header cell spanning four columns above the real column headers on row 2.

### Spreadsheet mess: notes column

- `DEF-NOTESCOL`: Every season's cost tab has a free-text Notes column, mostly blank.

### Spreadsheet mess: totals row inside data range

- `DEF-TOTALSROW-2019` (season 2019): The 2019 cost tab has a TOTAL row immediately after the last field row, inside the same contiguous data range, with no blank row separating it.

### Spreadsheet mess: transposed digit

- `DEF-DIGIT-2022-root_06` (season 2022): Seed cost cell for Riverside in 2022 reads 95.55 instead of the correct 59.55.

### Unit inconsistency (N rate)

- `DEF-UNIT-2022` (season 2022): As-applied nitrogen recorded in lb_N/ac for 2022.
- `DEF-UNIT-2023` (season 2023): As-applied nitrogen recorded in gal/ac of 32% UAN product for 2023; convert using 3.5392 lb N per gallon.
- `DEF-UNIT-2024` (season 2024): As-applied nitrogen recorded in lb_N/ac for 2024.
- `DEF-UNIT-2025` (season 2025): As-applied nitrogen recorded in gal/ac of 32% UAN product for 2025; convert using 3.5392 lb N per gallon.

### Weather shortfall (forced drought)

- `DEF-WEATHERSHORTFALL-2018-root_01` (season 2018): 2018's precipitation was deliberately forced to 35% of its otherwise-generated total -- a genuine drought shared by every field active that season (including 'West 120'), not a management failure.

### Yield monitor calibration error

- `DEF-CAL-2019-root_03` (season 2019): Yield monitor total (5,008 bu) is +6.9% off the scale ticket total (4,683 bu) on Home Quarter.
- `DEF-CAL-2021-root_11` (season 2021): Yield monitor total (13,468 bu) is -3.4% off the scale ticket total (13,938 bu) on Coulee Field.
- `DEF-CAL-2023-root_12` (season 2023): Yield monitor total (25,513 bu) is +3.8% off the scale ticket total (24,573 bu) on Section Corner.
- `DEF-CAL-2024-root_11` (season 2024): Yield monitor total (12,947 bu) is -5.9% off the scale ticket total (13,752 bu) on Coulee Field.

## Field identity

The farmer's field name is never a stable key across all ten seasons -- it drifts, gets formally renamed, and stops meaning anything across a split or merge. `ground_truth.json`'s `canonical_fields` and `identity_events` are the answer key for resolving this; the raw files (GeoJSON/CSV/XLSX) intentionally carry only the farmer-visible name as of that season, drift included, never an internal canonical ID.

## Limitations

- EPSG:26914 coordinates are produced by a lightweight planar approximation, not a full geodetic Transverse Mercator projection -- plausible magnitude and a correctly declared CRS, not survey-grade accuracy.
- Field boundaries are simple axis-aligned rectangles sized to match assigned acreage, not real parcel geometry.
